svg.text: High-DoF Dexterous Hand Manipulation & Humanoid Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation (WBC)
Hierarchical Control Decomposition: From High-Level Semantic VLA/WAM Planning to 500–1000 Hz Whole-Body & Finger Torque Tracking
(a) 20+ DoF Anthropomorphic Dexterous Manipulation
1. Curse of Dimensionality & Multi-Contact Physics (u in R^{22..28}):
• Parallel gripper (1-DoF) relies on stable cage grasps; 5-finger hands
(Shadow, Allegro, LEAP, SharpaWave) make/break 5–15 contacts/second.
• Grasp Wrench Matrix G(q) must satisfy friction cone constraints:
w_obj = G(q) f_contact, sqrt(f_t1^2 + f_t2^2) <= mu * f_normal
2. Dexterous Data Collection & Kinematic Retargeting:
• DexCap (RSS 2024) & DexUMI (2025): Wearable electromagnetic/exoskeleton
capture of in-the-wild human fingertip poses + wrist SLAM trajectories.
• DexMimicGen (2024): Automated simulation trajectory synthesis for
coordinated bimanual + 24-DoF dexterous hands.
3. Tactile-Guided In-Hand Reorientation & Assembly (PRISM, 2026):
• Point-cloud + fingertip array (3D-ViTac / AnySkin) resolves severe
visual self-occlusion by fingers during precision screw/clip insertion.
• Synergy eigengrasp prior + 100Hz tactile residual flow head
(b) Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation Control (WBC, 30–50+ DoF)
1. Floating-Base Coupled Dynamics & Null-Space Projection:
• Mobile bimanual & humanoid systems couple base/leg locomotion with
torso pitch/yaw and dual 7-DoF arms to expand manipulation workspace.
• Task-Priority Null-Space: dq = J_1^+ dx_1 + (I - J_1^+ J_1) J_2^+ dx_2
(Task 1: Balance/CoM & EE tracking; Task 2: Joint limit & posture)
2. Hierarchical VLA + RL Whole-Body Trackers (2024–2026 SOTA):
• Upper Layer (10–30 Hz): GR00T N1.5 / VioLA / SONIC generates upper-body
end-effector SE(3) trajectories, root velocity, and torso height commands.
• Lower Layer (500 Hz): HOVER (2024) / BeyondMimic (2025) / ASAP (2025)
RL whole-body policy outputs joint PD targets maintaining ZMP stability.
3. Sim-to-Real Physics Alignment (ASAP, RSS 2025):
• Stage 1: Train agile whole-body motion tracker inIsaac Lab / Newton.
• Stage 2: Train Delta-Action residual dynamics model on real humanoid
rollouts to bridge actuator friction, delay, and foot contact mismatch.
